verdict.rationale: LibreChat is a self-hosted web chat app, but it documents a beta Agent Management API that lets machine clients authenticate through deployment-bound OIDC identities and create, update and delete agents, files and Skills. It also publishes an OpenAPI spec and documents Scheduled Chats. Together these give some non-interactive, programmatic use, but the evidence does not show agents or chats being run headlessly or inside CI pipelines. Docker, npm and Helm deployment options are hosting methods, not headless automation, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: a documented headless or CLI mode for running chats or agents non-interactively, CI integration docs or examples, a non-beta API for executing agent runs, independent hands-on corroboration.
